description: This file defines the UserDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface to provide data access methods for User entities, including retrieving users by username, listing all users, and listing users associated with a specific merchant store.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: The UserDao interface provides methods to access User data, including fetching a user by username, listing all users, and listing users filtered by store.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity based on the provided username.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Returns a list of all User entities.

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Fetches a list of users associated with a specific MerchantStore.
